items.e: And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah toward the way of the south, and teach concerning the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field of the south.

And say to the forest of the south: Accept the word of Hashem! Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will consume in you every dry tree; the consuming flame will not be extinguished, and all faces from south to north will be marked by it.
And all flesh will see that I, Hashem, have kindled it; it will not be extinguished."
And I said: "Accept my prayer, Hashem Elokim! Behold, they are saying of me, 'Is he not just posing parables?'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning Yerushalayim, and teach concerning the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Yisrael.

And say to the land of Yisrael: Thus said Hashem: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, and I will draw My sword from its sheath, and I will exile from you your righteous ones in order to destroy your wicked ones.
Because I exile from you your righteous ones in order to destroy your wicked ones, therefore My sword will go forth from its sheath against all flesh, from south to north.
And all flesh will know that I, Hashem, have drawn My sword from its sheath; it will not return again.
And you, ben adam, groan with trembling of the loins, and with bitterness groan before their eyes.

And it will be, when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' that you shall say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming! And every heart will melt, and all hands will grow weak, and every spirit will faint, and all knees will pour out water; behold, it is coming and it will be fulfilled, says Hashem Elokim.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, prophesy and say: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Say, 'A sword! The sword of the king of Bavel shall kill, and the sword of the children of Ammon shall be doubled and make an end!'

In order to perform a slaughter it is drawn; in order to execute retribution it is polished, because the tribe of the house of Yehudah and Binyamin rejoiced over the tribes of Yisrael when they were exiled because they worshipped idols, and they themselves returned to go astray after idols of wood.
And He gave their retribution to be delivered into the hand of the king of Bavel; it will be the strike of the sword, their retribution to deliver them into the hand of killers.

Cry and wail, ben adam, for it has come upon My people, it and all the princes of Yisrael; those killed by the sword are gathered, and they have come against My people from all around; therefore, strike upon your thigh!

For the neviim prophesied to them and they did not repent, and what will be their end? Say, 'Even the tribe of the house of Yehudah and Binyamin shall surely be exiled, and through their evil deeds they shall not endure, says Hashem Elokim.'
And you, ben adam, prophesy and clap hand to hand, and let the sword be doubled a third time—it is the sword of killers, the sword of great retribution that terrifies them.
In order to break their heart and multiply their stumbling blocks upon all their cities, I have appointed the killers of the sword; woe, the sword is drawn to kill, it is polished to make an end!
Be sharp and kill from the south, and destroy from the north—wherever your face is destined to go!
And I too will bring retribution upon retribution, and I will rest My wrath; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"And you, ben adam, set for yourself two ways by which the killers of the sword of the king of Bavel may come; from this same province both of them shall go forth; and mark a place at the head of the intersection of the city, mark a place.
Mark a way by which the killers of the sword may come to Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and to the house of Yehudah who went out of Yerushalayim to dwell in fortified cities.
For the king of Bavel stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to practice divination; he shot with arrows, he inquired of idols, he looked at the liver.

In his right hand was the divination falling to go to Yerushalayim, to set up battering rams, to open gates for killers to enter, to raise the voice with the shouting of the horn, to set up battering rams against the gates, to heap up a mound, and to build a siege wall.

And their divinations were like lies in their eyes, omens which he divined for them; and they did not know that forty-nine times he lay in wait and delayed the matter, until the hour came for them to be delivered into his hand.

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have brought your sins to remembrance by revealing your rebellions, so that your sins appear in all your deeds—because you have brought them to remembrance, into the hand of the king of Bavel you shall be delivered.
And you, slain wicked one, prince of Yisrael, whose day of ruin has arrived, the time of the payment for his sins:

Thus said Hashem Elokim: Remove the turban of Seraiah the Kohen Gadol, and I will nullify the crown from Tzidkiyah the king! Neither this one nor that one shall remain in his place; Gedalyah bar Achikam, to whom it does not belong, shall take it, and Tzidkiyah, to whom it belongs, it shall be removed from him.

Their sins by which they sinned, like their sins I will take retribution from them; even for this one it shall not endure, until I bring upon him the retribution of Yishmael bar Netanyah and deliver him into his hand.

And you, ben adam, prophesy and say: Thus said Hashem Elokim concerning the children of Ammon and concerning their reproaches, and you shall say: 'A sword, a sword is drawn to kill, polished to destroy, to make it flash!

While they prophesy falsehood to you, while they divine lies to you, to set your neck upon the necks of the slain of the wicked whose day of ruin has arrived, the time of the visitation of their evil.
Return the sword to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your dwelling, I will judge you.
And I will pour out My wrath upon you, with the fire of My retribution I will blow upon you, and I will deliver you into the hand of wicked men, skilled in destruction.

To nations that are strong as fire you shall be delivered for destruction; the guilt of your bloodshed shall be in the midst of the land; your memory shall no longer enter, for I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"And you, ben adam, will you rebuke, will you rebuke the city that sheds innocent blood in its midst? Then make known to her all her abominations.
And you shall say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: O city that sheds innocent blood in its midst, the time of her ruin has arrived; and they worship idols in her to become defiled!

By the guilt of the innocent blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and through the worship of your idols that you have served you have become defiled; and you have brought near the day of your ruin, and the time of your evil has arrived. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the provinces.
Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, whose name is unclean, whose turmoil is great.
Behold, the princes of Yisrael, each according to his power, were in you to shed innocent blood.
Father and mother they degraded in you; to the stranger they committed oppression in your midst; the orphan and widow they wronged in you.
My holy things you despised, and My Shabbos days you profaned.
Men who are slanderers were in you to shed innocent blood; and upon the mountains they worshipped idols in you, for they committed sinful counsel in your midst.
The nakedness of a father they uncovered in you; a woman in her impurity they oppressed in you.
And a man committed abomination with his neighbor's wife, and a man defiled his daughter-in-law through sinful counsel, and a man oppressed his sister, his father's daughter, in you.
Bribes they took in you to shed innocent blood; usury and interest you took, and you gained from your neighbors by oppression, and My service you forsook, says Hashem Elokim.
And behold, I have brought My retribution upon you for the ill-gotten monetary gain of your oppression that you committed, and for the innocent blood that was shed in your midst.
Will your heart remain steadfast, or will your hands be strong, in the days that I am about to deal with you? I, Hashem, have decreed by My word, and I will fulfill it.
And I will exile you among the nations, and scatter you among the provinces, and I will remove your uncleanness from you.
And I will be sanctified through you in the eyes of the nations, and you shall know that I am Hashem.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, the house of Yisrael has become like dross before Me, all of them; as brass, tin, iron, and lead are mixed in the midst of a furnace, they have become like the dross of silver.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have all become like dross, therefore behold, I am gathering you into the midst of Yerushalayim.
As they gather silver, brass, iron, lead, and tin into the midst of a furnace to blow the fire upon it to melt it, so will I gather in My anger and in My wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
And I will gather you, and I will blow upon you with the fire of My retribution, and you shall be melted in its midst.
As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so shall you be melted in its midst; and you shall know that I, Hashem, have poured out My wrath upon you."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, say to her: You are the land of Yisrael, a land that is not cleansed, nor were good deeds performed in her to protect her in the day of curse.
The band of her scribes in her midst are like roaring lions committing slaughter; they have devoured human life, they have taken wealth and glory, and her widows they have multiplied in her midst.

Her kohanim have violated My Torah and profaned My holy things; between the holy and the profane they made no distinction, and between the unclean and the clean they did not make known; and from My Shabbos days they closed their eyes, and My will was profaned among them.
Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing prey, shedding innocent blood and destroying souls to obtain false monetary gain.

And her false prophets are like those who build a partition wall and smear it with untempered clay that has no straw, prophesying falsehood and teaching them lies, saying, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim,' when from before Hashem it was not spoken.
The people of the land have committed oppression and executed robbery; the poor and needy they have wronged, and the stranger they have oppressed unlawfully.
And I sought among them for a man possessing good deeds who would stand in the breach before Me and seek mercy for the people of the land so that I should not destroy it, but I found none.
Therefore I have poured out My wrath upon them; with the fire of My retribution I have consumed them; the retribution of their ways I have placed upon their heads, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, prophesy concerning two provinces that were like two women, daughters of one mother.
And they went astray in Mitzrayim after the worship of their idols; they went astray there, serving idols, and there they corrupted their deeds.

And their names were Oholah, the older, and Oholivah, her sister; and they served before Me and prospered with sons and daughters; and their names were Shomron, which is Oholah, and Yerushalayim, which is Oholivah.
And Oholah went astray from My service, and she desired to go astray after her lovers, after the Assyrians, her neighbors;
Clothed in perfection, rulers and governors, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
And she desired to go astray after them, all the elite of the Assyrians; and with all whom she desired, with all the worship of their idols, she was defiled.
And the worship of the idols that was with her from Mitzrayim she did not forsake, for they forced her to worship their idols, and they taught her evil deeds and poured their idols upon her.
Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, after whom she desired to go astray.

They uncovered her disgrace, her sons and her daughters they took captive, and her people they killed with the sword; and she became a byword among provinces, and they executed judgments of punishment upon her.
And her sister Oholivah saw this, and she corrupted her desire more than she, and her idol worship more than the idol worship of her sister.
After the Assyrians she desired to go astray, rulers and governors nearby, clothed in perfection, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
And it was revealed before Me that she was defiled; both of them took one way.
And she added to her idol worship: she saw men depicted upon the wall, images of the Kasdim depicted with pigments;
Girded with belts on their loins, with hanging turbans on their heads, all of them looking like mighty men, the likeness of the Babylonians of the land of the Kasdim, the land of their birth.
And she desired to go astray after them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them to the land of the Kasdim.
And the Babylonians came to her for love, and defiled her with their idols; and she was defiled by them until her soul was alienated from them.
And her shame was uncovered and her disgrace was seen, and My word rejected her just as My word had rejected her sister.
And she multiplied her idol worship, remembering the days of old when she went astray in the land of Mitzrayim.
And she desired to be submissive to those whose flesh is like the flesh of donkeys, and whose discharge is like the discharge of horses.
And you brought to mind the sins of your sinful counsel of old, in your desire for Mitzrayim because of the sins of your youth.
Therefore, Oholivah, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am openly bringing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul was alienated, and I will bring them against you from all around:
The Babylonians, and all the Kasdim, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; desirable young men, rulers and governors, all of them mighty men of renown, riding on horses.

And they shall come against you with weapons of war, with chariots and wheels, and a assembly of nations armed with shields and helmets; they will set themselves against you all around, and I will place judgments before them, and they will punish you according to their laws.

And I will place My retribution upon you, and they will deal with you in anger; your rulers and your nobles they will exile, and your people shall be killed with the sword; they shall take captive your sons and your daughters, and the beauty of your land shall be burned with fire.
And they shall strip you of your glorious garments and take your precious vessels.

And I will nullify the sins of your sinful counsel from you, and the worship of your idols that was with you when you were in the land of Mitzrayim; and you shall not lift up your eyes to them, and the idols of the Egyptians you shall remember no more.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am delivering you into the hand of those whom you hate, into the hand of those from whom your soul was alienated.

And they will deal with you in hatred, and take away all the fruit of your labor, and leave you wandering and forsaken; and the shame of your straying shall be uncovered, and the sins of your sinful counsel and your pride.
Your sins have brought these things upon you, because you went astray after the nations, and were defiled with the worship of their idols.
In the way of your sister you have walked; therefore I will put her cup of retribution into your hand.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: The cup of your sister's retribution you shall drink, deep and large; you shall be for laughter and for mockery, from the abundance of trouble that shall come upon you.
You shall be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of desolation and astonishment, the cup of retribution of your sister Shomron.
And you shall drink it and drain it dry, and you shall receive its retribution, and tear your own flesh; for I have decreed it by My word, says Hashem Elokim.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have forsaken My service and cast the fear of Me behind your eyes, you too bear the sins of your sinful counsel and your idol worship."
And Hashem said to me: "Ben adam, will you rebuke Oholah and Oholivah? Then make known to them their abominations!

For they have committed adultery, and innocent blood is on their hands, and after the worship of their idols they went astray; and even their children, who were destined to bring forth holy descendants before Me, they passed through to them for worship.
Moreover, they provoked Me to anger: they defiled My Sanctuary on that day, and My Shabbos days they profaned.
And when they slaughtered their children for the worship of their idols, they came into My Sanctuary on that same day to profane it; and behold, thus they have done in the midst of My Sanctuary.
And furthermore, you sent for men coming from afar, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came! For whom you prepared yourself, set up markets, and appointed inns;
And you sat upon an exalted couch, with a table prepared before them full of all good things, and My incense and My oil you set upon it.

And the sound of a tumultuous crowd at ease was with them, and along with men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon their hands and a glorious crown upon their heads.
Then I said concerning the Congregation of Yisrael, which was consumed by her sins: 'Now let her leave her idol worship and return to My service!' But she did not return.
And they went in to her as one goes in to an innkeeper woman; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholivah, women of sinful counsel.
And righteous men shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and the judgment of those who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and innocent blood is on their hands.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Prophesy that armies shall come up against them, and I will give them over to terror and to spoil.
And the armies shall stone them with slingstones and cut them down with their swords; they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.
Thus I will nullify the sins of sinful counsel from the land, that all provinces may be chastened and not act according to your sinful counsel.
And they shall place the sins of your counsel upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your idol worship; and you shall know that I am Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying:
"Ben adam, write for yourself the name of the day, this selfsame day; the king of Bavel pressed against Yerushalayim on this selfsame day.

And prophesy a nevuah against the rebellious people, and say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Prophesy that armies shall go up against this city, and an extension shall also be given to it to receive a siege.
Gather her princes into her midst, every man who makes war; fill her with an army of nations.
Gather the kings of the nations, and also set her supports with them; hasten her time, and let her slain also be thrown into her midst.'

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Woe to the city that sheds innocent blood in her midst, which is like a pot whose filth is in it, and whose filth has not gone out of it! Bring her out exile by exile, the people who went out because teshuvah was not performed in her.
For the innocent blood that was shed in her midst was shed with presumption and an outstretched arm; you did not spill it inadvertently to perform teshuvah for it.
To execute retribution, to take vengeance with force, I have uncovered their sins openly for having shed innocent blood, so that it should not be forgiven.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Woe to the city that sheds innocent blood in her midst! I too will multiply her destruction.
Multiply the kings, gather the armies, set the supports, and prepare the warriors against her; and her mighty men shall be confused.
And leave the land desolate, so that the gates of her city may be desolated and perish, and those who perform her uncleanness shall melt in her midst, and her sins shall come to an end.
She is filled with afflictions, and those who do evil shall not go out from her; she shall be burned with fire because of the greatness of her sin.
Because you were defiled with sinful counsel, instead of My purifying you—and you were not purified from your uncleanness—you shall no longer be purified until I rest My wrath upon you.

I, Hashem, have decreed by My word; it is coming and it will be fulfilled! I will not withhold, nor will I spare, nor will I have mercy; according to your evil ways and according to your corrupt deeds I will judge you, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, behold, I am taking from you the desire of your eyes by a plague, but you shall not lament, nor weep, nor shed tears.
Groan in silence; do not make mourning for the dead; let your turbans be upon you, and put your shoes on your feet; do not cover your mustache, and do not eat the bread of mourners."
So I prophesied to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening; and I did in the morning just as I was commanded.
And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing so?"
And I said to them, "The word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

Say to the house of Yisrael, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am profaning My Sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and the affection of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind shall fall by the sword.
And you shall do just as I have done: you shall not cover your mustache, nor shall you eat the bread of mourners.
And your turbans shall be on your heads, and your shoes on your feet; you shall not lament nor weep, but you shall melt away in your iniquities and groan one to another.
Thus Yechezkel shall be a sign to you; according to all that he has done you shall do when it comes, and you shall know that I am Hashem Elokim.'

And you, ben adam, shall it not be on the day when I take from them their Sanctuary, the pride of their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and the affection of their soul, which is better to them than their sons and their daughters,
On that day an escaped one will come to you to report the news.
On that day your mouth will be opened upon the coming of the escaped one, and you shall prophesy and no longer be silent; and you shall be a sign to them, and they shall know that I am Hashem."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

And say to the children of Ammon: Accept the word of Hashem Elokim! Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you said, 'Aha!' in joy over My Sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Yisrael when it was desolated, and over the house of Yehudah when they went into exile;

Therefore behold, I am delivering you to the people of the east for an inheritance, and they shall set up their fortresses in you and make their dwellings in you; they shall eat the produce of your land, and they shall spoil your possessions.
And I will make Rabbah a dwelling place for camels, and the children of Ammon a place for flocks of sheep to lie down; and you shall know that I am Hashem.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you clapped your hands, stamped your feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Yisrael;

Therefore behold, I am raising the blow of My might against you, and I will deliver you as spoil to the nations, and I will cut you off from among the nations, and I will destroy you from the provinces; I will desolate you, and you shall know that I am Hashem.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because Moab and Seir said, 'How are the house of Yehudah different from all the nations?'
Therefore behold, I am breaking the strength of Moab from their cities, from their fortified towns unto their borders, the glory of their land—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim;
To the people of the east, along with the children of Ammon, I will give it for an inheritance, so that the children of Ammon shall no longer be remembered among the nations.
And upon Moab I will execute judgments of punishment; and they shall know that I am Hashem.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because the Edomites acted with fierce vengeance against the house of Yehudah, and incurred great guilt, and took vengeance upon them;

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: I will raise the blow of My might against Edom, and I will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it a desolation from the south, and the inhabitants of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

And I will place My retribution upon Edom by the hand of My people Yisrael, and they shall be delivered and shall take vengeance upon Edom according to My anger and according to My wrath; and they shall know My retribution, says Hashem Elokim.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because the Philistines acted in hatred, and took vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with an everlasting enmity;

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am raising the blow of My might against the Philistines, and I will cut off the people who are doomed to destruction, and I will destroy the remnant of the seacoast.
And I will execute great vengeance upon them with fierce wrath; and they shall know that I am Hashem, when I place My retribution upon them."
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, because Tzor said concerning Yerushalayim, 'Aha! The gate of the nations that supplied merchandise to all the peoples is broken; it has turned to come to me, for she who was full is laid waste!'
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, O Tzor, and I will bring up against you an army of many nations, as the sea brings up its roaring waves.
And they shall destroy the walls of Tzor and break down her towers; and I will scrape her dust from her, and I will make her a bare, shining rock.
A place for spreading nets she shall be in the midst of the sea, for I have decreed it by My word, says Hashem Elokim; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.
And the inhabitants of her villages that are in the field shall be killed with the sword; and they shall know that I am Hashem.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am bringing upon Tzor Nevuchadretzar king of Bavel from the north, a king of kings, with horses, chariots, horsemen, an assembly of armies, and many people.
The inhabitants of your villages in the field he shall kill with the sword; and he shall build a siege wall against you, heap up a mound against you, and set up armed men with shields against you.
And the blow of his battering rams he shall place against your walls, and your towers he shall break down with his iron engines.

From the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover you; at the sound of horsemen, wheels, and chariots your walls shall shake, when he enters through your gates as men enter a city broken through from its wall.
With the hooves of his horses he shall trample all your streets; your people he shall kill with the sword, and the pillars of your strength he shall cast down to the ground.

And they shall spoil your wealth, plunder your merchandise, tear down your walls, and break down your desirable houses; and your stones, your timber, and your dust they shall place in the midst of the sea.
And I will cause the tumult of your songs to cease, and the sound of the music of your harps shall no longer be heard.
And I will make you a bare, shining rock; a place for spreading nets you shall be, and you shall no longer be rebuilt, for I, Hashem, have decreed it by My word, says Hashem Elokim.
Thus said Hashem Elokim to Tzor: Shall not the suburbs shake at the sound of the fall of your slain, at the groan of those pierced by the sword when the slain fall in your midst?

And all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments; they shall clothe themselves with trembling, sit upon the ground, tremble at their ruin, and be astonished over you.

And they shall raise a lamentation over you and say to you: 'How you have perished, who dwelt in the midst of the seas, the praised city that was strong in the sea—she and her inhabitants! How have all her inhabitants been delivered to ruin!'
Now shall the suburbs tremble in the day of the fall of your slain, and the islands that are in the sea shall be dismayed at the going forth of your exile.

For thus said Hashem Elokim: When I make you a desolate city, like cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up against you an army of nations as many as the waters of the deep, and many nations shall cover you;

And I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction, to the people of old; and I will desolate you in the lower earth, in eternal ruins with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction, so that you shall not be inhabited; but I will set joy in the land of Yisrael.
I will make you as if you had never been, and so shall you be; and you shall be sought, but you shall no longer be found forever, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"And you, ben adam, lift up a lamentation over Tzor.
And say to Tzor, who dwells at the entryways of the sea ports, supplying merchandise to the nations, to many islands: Thus said Hashem Elokim: O Tzor, you have said, 'I am perfect in my beauty.'
Your borders are in the midst of the seas; your architects perfected your beauty.
Fir trees from Senir they built for you for all your planks; cedars from Levanon they took to make masts for you.
Oaks from Bashan they made into your oars; your gate benches are boards of boxwood inlaid with elephant ivory, covered, to be brought from the province of Apulia.
Fine linen with embroidery from Mitzrayim was your sail, to serve as a sign for you; blue and purple wool from the province of Italy was your covering.
The inhabitants of Tzidon and Arvad were rowers and brought merchandise into your midst; your wise men, O Tzor, were in you, they were your leaders.
The elders of Geval and her wise men were in you, repairing your breaches; all the seafarers and their mariners were rowing and bringing merchandise into your midst.
Persians, Ludim, and Putim were in your army, your men of war; shields and helmets they hung in you, they increased your splendor.
The children of Arvad and all your army were upon your walls all around, and Cappadocians were in your towers; their shields they hung upon your walls all around, they perfected your beauty.
From the sea they brought merchandise into your midst; with an abundance of all wealth, in silver, iron, tin, and lead, they paid into your treasury.
Yavan, Tuval, and Meshech were your merchants; in human souls and copper vessels they brought merchandise into your midst.
From the province of Germania horses, horsemen, and mules they brought as merchandise into your midst.
The children of Dedan were your merchants; the inhabitants of many islands brought merchandise into your midst; with horns of ibex, elephant ivory, and peacocks they returned your offerings.
From Aram they brought merchandise into your midst from the greatness of your wealth; in wraps of purple, embroidery, fine linen, drawings, precious stones, and pearls they paid into your treasury.
Yehudah and the land of Yisrael were your merchants; in wheat, rice, sweetmeats, honey, oil, and balsam they paid into your stores.
From Dammesek they brought merchandise into your midst through the abundance of your wealth, from the abundance of all wealth, in wine of Helbon and white wool.
And Dan and Yavan brought songs into your trade; in bars of iron, cassia, and sweet reed they paid into your stores.
From Dedan they brought merchandise into your midst in precious garments for chariots.
Arabia and all the princes of Nevat were your merchants; in bulls, rams, and goats, in these was your trade.
The merchants of Sheva and Raamah were your merchants; with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones and gold they paid into your treasury.
Charan, Netzivin, and Hadyev, the merchants of Sheva, the provinces of Ashur and Media were your merchants.

They were your merchants in perfection of all praise, in bundles of blue wool, chests of cedar wood, with robes of scarlet tied in trunks, covered with leather, bound with cords of fine linen, sealed with engraved rings, the work of the sea, placed in towers of myrtle wood—in these was your trade.
In ships of the sea they were sailing and bringing merchandise into your midst; and you became wealthy and very strong in the midst of the seas.
Into many waters they brought you, and they plundered you; a king who is strong as the east wind broke you in the midst of the seas.

Your wealth, your possessions, your merchandise, your mariners, your leaders, those who repair your breaches, those who bring your store merchandise, all your men of war who are in you, and all your assembly in your midst shall fall into the midst of the seas on the day of the fall of your slain.
At the sound of the outcry of your leaders, the suburbs shall tremble.
And all who hold the oar, the mariners, all the leaders of the sea shall come down from their ships; they shall stand upon the land.
And they shall cause their voice to be heard concerning you, and cry bitterly; they shall throw dust upon their heads, and roll themselves in ashes.
And they shall make themselves bald for you, gird themselves with sackcloth, weep over you in bitterness of soul, and make bitter lamentation.
And in their affliction they shall raise a lamentation over you and wail over you: 'Who is like Tzor, who is like her in the midst of the sea?'
When your merchandise went forth from among the nations, you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your possessions you enriched the kings of the earth.
Now you are broken, who supplied merchandise to the nations in the depths of the sea; your merchandise and all your assembly in your midst have fallen.
All the inhabitants of the islands are desolated over you, and their kings are greatly afraid, their faces are marked.
The merchants among the nations are desolated over you; you shall be as if you had never been, and so shall you be forever."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, say to the king of Tzor: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because your heart has grown haughty, and you have said, 'I am a god, I sit in the seat of the mighty in the midst of the seas!'—yet you are a man and there is no need for you, though you have considered in your heart that you are a god;
Behold, you are wiser than Daniel! No secret is hidden from you!
By your wisdom and by your understanding you have acquired wealth for yourself, and gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;
By the abundance of your wisdom and by your great trade your armies have multiplied, and your heart has grown haughty with your armies;
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have considered in your heart that you are a god,

Therefore behold, I am bringing strangers upon you, the most ruthless of the nations, and they will draw their swords against the perfection of your wisdom, and they will ruin the splendor of your terror.
To the pit they will bring you down, and you shall die the death of those slain by the sword in the midst of the seas.
Will you still say, 'I am a god,' before the one who kills you? Yet you are a man, and there is no need for you, in the hand of the one who destroys you!
You shall die the death of the wicked by the hand of strangers; for I have decreed it by My word, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, lift up a lamentation over the king of Tzor, and say to him: Thus said Hashem Elokim: You were like a vessel of exquisite form, filled with wisdom and perfected in beauty.

In the abundance of good things and delights you were delighted, as if you dwelt in Eden, the garden of Hashem; all pride of wealth and honor was given to you. Every precious stone was set upon your garment—ruby, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, emerald, and carbuncle—embedded in gold; all these were prepared for your adornment. Therefore your heart grew haughty, yet you did not look upon your own body, which was formed with cavities and openings—necessary needs without which it is impossible for you to exist, which were prepared with you from the day you were created.
You were a king anointed to rule, and I gave you greatness; but you degraded the holy mountain of Hashem, and over the holy people you thought to rule.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until falsehood was found in you.

By the abundance of your merchandise your treasuries were filled with plunder, and you sinned; therefore I have profaned you from the holy mountain of Hashem, and I have destroyed you, O mighty king, because you thought to rule over the holy people.

Your heart grew haughty in your strength, you corrupted your wisdom because of the splendor of your terror; I have cast you down to the ground, I have set you as a warning before kings, that they may look upon you.

Through the greatness of your sin, in the falsehood of your trade, you have profaned your sanctuary; therefore I brought forth nations strong as fire because of your willful sins, and they shall consume you, and I will reduce you to ash upon the earth in the sight of all who see you.
All who knew you among the nations are desolated over you; you shall be as if you had never been, and so shall you be forever."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning Tzidon, and prophesy against her.

And say: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, O Tzidon, and I will be glorified in your midst; and they shall know that I am Hashem, when I execute judgments of punishment in you, and am sanctified through her.

And I will send pestilence into her, and slaughter in her streets; and the slain shall fall in her midst when I bring those who kill with the sword against her from all around; and they shall know that I am Hashem.
And there shall no longer be for the house of Yisrael an injurious king or an oppressing ruler among all their neighbors who plunder them; and they shall know that I am Hashem Elokim.

Thus said Hashem Elokim: When I gather the house of Yisrael from among the nations where they were scattered, and am sanctified through them in the eyes of the nations, then shall they dwell upon their land which I gave to My servant Yaakov.

And they shall dwell upon it in security, build houses, plant vineyards, and dwell in security when I execute judgments of punishment upon all those who plunder them from among their neighbors; and they shall know that I am Hashem their God."
In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, and prophesy against him and against all the Egyptians.

Prophesy and say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, who are like a great dragon lurking in the midst of his rivers, who said, "The kingdom is mine, and I made it!"

And I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will kill the rulers of your strength along with your mighty men, and I will remove you from your kingdom; and all the rulers of your strength with your mighty men shall be killed.

And I will cast you into the wilderness, you and all the rulers of your strength; upon the open field your carcass shall fall; it shall not be gathered nor buried; to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens I have delivered you to be consumed.
And all the inhabitants of Mitzrayim shall know that I am Hashem, because they have been a staff of a broken reed to the house of Yisrael.
When they took hold of you by hand, you were delivered into the hand of a mighty king, and their place of trust perished; and when they leaned upon you, you broke and were no support to them.'
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am bringing upon you those who kill with the sword, and I will cut off man and beast from you.
And the land of Mitzrayim shall become an astonishment and a desolation, and they shall know that I am Hashem, because he said, 'The kingdom is mine, and I made it!'
Therefore behold, I am sending My anger against you and against your kingdoms, and I will make the land of Mitzrayim a utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Svenah unto the border of Kush.
No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, nor shall it be inhabited forty years.

And I will make the land of Mitzrayim a desolation in the midst of desolated provinces, and her cities in the midst of ruined cities shall be a desolation forty years; and I will exile the Egyptians among the nations, and scatter them among the provinces.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from among the nations where they were scattered.
And I will return the exiles of Mitzrayim, and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their habitation, and they shall be there a lowly kingdom.
It shall be the lowliest of the kingdoms, nor shall it exalt itself anymore over the nations; and I will diminish them, so that they shall not rule over the nations.
And it shall no longer be a confidence for the house of Yisrael, bringing sins to remembrance when they turn after them; and they shall know that I am Hashem Elokim."
And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, Nevuchadretzar king of Bavel made his army serve a great service against Tzor; every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled; yet he had no wages, nor his army, from Tzor for the service that he served against her.

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am giving the land of Mitzrayim to Nevuchadretzar king of Bavel; and he shall carry off her crowd, take her spoil, and plunder her booty; and it shall be the wages for his army.
His wages for which he served I have given him—the land of Mitzrayim—because they sinned before Me, to take retribution from them, says Hashem Elokim.
On that day I will bring salvation to the house of Yisrael, and to you I will give the opening of the mouth in nevuah in their midst; and they shall know that I am Hashem."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, prophesy and say: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Wail and say, 'Woe for the day!'
For the day is near, the day is near that is destined to come from before Hashem; a day of cloud and panic, a time of ruin for the nations it shall be.
And a sword shall come upon Mitzrayim, and there shall be panic in Kush when the slain fall in Mitzrayim, and they carry off her crowd, and her foundations are broken down.
Cushites, Putites, Ludim, and all the allied troops, and Chub, and the people of the land of the covenant with them, shall fall by the sword.
Thus said Hashem: The supporters of Mitzrayim shall fall, and the pride of her strength shall be brought to an end; from Migdol to Svenah they shall fall by the sword in her, says Hashem Elokim.
And they shall be desolated in the midst of desolated provinces, and her cities shall be in the midst of ruined cities.
And they shall know that I am Hashem, when I place nations strong as fire upon Mitzrayim, and all her supporters are broken.
At that time messengers shall go forth from before Me in ships to terrify secure Kush, and there shall be panic among them as on the day of Mitzrayim; for behold, it is coming!
Thus said Hashem Elokim: I will cause the crowd of Mitzrayim to cease by the hand of Nevuchadretzar king of Bavel.
He and his people with him, the ruthless of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Mitzrayim, and fill the land with the slain.
And I will make her rivers dry land, and sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will desolate the land and its fullness by the hand of wicked men; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.

Thus said Hashem Elokim: I will destroy those who worship idols, and make an end of those who worship images from Mofes; and a king from the land of Mitzrayim shall no longer arise, and I will place fear in the land of Mitzrayim.
And I will desolate Pathros, and place nations strong as fire upon Tanes, and execute judgments of punishment in Alexandria.
And I will pour out My wrath upon Sin, the strength of Mitzrayim; and I will cut off the crowd of Alexandria.
And I will place nations strong as fire in Mitzrayim; Sin shall tremble greatly, Alexandria shall be broken through from its wall, and enemies shall surround Mofes day by day.
The young men of Aven and Pibeseth shall fall by the sword, and their worshippers shall go into captivity.

And at Takhpankhes the day shall be darkened when I break there the strength of Mitzrayim, and the pride of her power shall cease in her; a king with his armies shall cover her like a cloud that rises and covers the land, and the inhabitants of her villages shall go into captivity.
Thus I will execute judgments of punishment in Mitzrayim; and they shall know that I am Hashem."
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, I have broken the strength of Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim; and behold, it has not been bound up to be healed, to apply remedies, to make it strong to hold the kingdom.

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger upon Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, and I will break his supporters and his strong rulers through whom he broke kingdoms, and I will cast his strength from him.
And I will exile the Egyptians among the nations, and scatter them among the provinces.

And I will strengthen the kingdom of the king of Bavel, and put My strength in his hand; and I will break the strength of Pharaoh, and he shall groan the groans of one wounded by the sword before him.

And I will strengthen the kingdom of the king of Bavel, and the kingdom of Pharaoh shall cease; and they shall know that I am Hashem, when I put My strength into the hand of the king of Bavel, and he executes retribution upon the land of Mitzrayim.
And I will exile the Egyptians among the nations, and scatter them among the provinces; and they shall know that I am Hashem."
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, say to Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim and to his crowd: Whom are you like in your greatness?
Behold, the Assyrian was like a cedar in Levanon, with beautiful branches, with boughs casting shade, high in stature, and sending its roots upon watercourses.
Among many nations he was strong in his supports; he subjected kings beneath his kingdom, and appointed his rulers over every province of the earth.
Therefore he grew haughty in his strength above all the kings of the earth, and his armies multiplied, and his supports triumphed over many nations in his triumph.
In his armies he crushed all strong fortresses, and beneath his rule he subjected every province of the earth, and in the shade of his kingdom dwelt all many nations.
And he triumphed in his supports through the abundance of his warriors, for his fear was upon many nations.

Mighty kings could not triumph against him with the force of power that was with him from before Hashem; rulers could not stand before his armies, and warriors could not compare to his supports; with the force of power that was with him from before Hashem, nothing was like him in his strength.
I made his work beautiful through the abundance of his warriors, and all the kings of the east trembled before him with the force of power that was with him from before Hashem.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you grew high in stature, and placed his lordship over kingdoms, and his heart grew haughty in his strength,
I delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he executed retribution upon him, and according to his sin I drove him out.

And strangers, the most ruthless of the nations, destroyed him and cast him away upon the mountains, and in every valley his army fell; and his supports were scattered in all the riverbeds of the earth, and all the peoples of the earth came down from the shade of his kingdom and cast him away.
Upon the fall of his slain all the birds of the heavens settled, and upon the carcasses of his army rested every beast of the field;

So that none of the kings of the east should grow haughty in their strength, nor set their lordship over kingdoms, nor all those who serve kings exalt themselves in their strength; for all of them are delivered unto death, to the lower earth, in the midst of human beings, with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction.

Thus said Hashem Elokim: On the day I brought him down to Sheol, they mourned for him; distress covered the world, and provinces were desolated, and many nations trembled, and the faces of kings grew dark for him, and all the kings of the nations clapped their hands over him.

At the sound of his fall I caused nations to shake, when I brought him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction; and all the kings of the east, rulers and those wealthy in possessions, all who serve kings, were comforted in the lower earth.
They too went down with him to Sheol, with those slain by the sword; and his rulers were broken, those who strengthened them in the midst of the kingdom.

To whom are you thus likened in glory and in greatness among the kings of the east? Yet you shall be brought down with the kings of the east to the lower earth; in the midst of the wicked you shall lie with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his crowd, says Hashem Elokim."
And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, lift up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, and say to him: You were mighty among the nations, and you are like a dragon in the seas; you gushed forth with your army, and caused panic among the nations with your supports, and desolated their provinces.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: I will spread My net over you in an assembly of many nations, and they shall haul you up in My dragnet.

And I will cast you upon the land; upon the open field I will throw your carcass, and I will cause all the birds of the heavens to settle upon you, and I will satisfy the beasts of all the earth with you.
And I will lay the flesh of your slain upon the mountains, and the valleys shall be filled with the corpses of your armies.
And I will drench the land of your pleasure with your blood upon the mountains, and the riverbeds shall be filled with you.

And distress shall cover you when I extinguish the glory of the splendor of your kingdom; from the heavens they shall grow small along with your armies, which were as numerous as the stars. A king with his armies shall cover you like a cloud that rises and covers the sun, and like the moon, its light shall not shine by day.

All the set pathways of your ways that are prepared and kept in your midst—behold, like the bright lights in the heavens I will ruin them over you, and distress shall cover your land like darkness, says Hashem Elokim.
And I will dismay the heart of many peoples when I bring the broken remnants of your war among the nations, into provinces you have not known.

And I will desolate many peoples over you, and their kings shall be greatly astonished at you when I bring against you those who kill with the sword; and they shall see and tremble at their own ruin, every man for his own soul, on the day of the fall of your slain.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Those who kill with the sword, the king of Bavel, shall come upon you.
By the sword of warriors I will cast down your crowd, the most ruthless of the nations, all of them; and they shall spoil the strength of Mitzrayim, and all her crowd shall be destroyed.
And I will destroy all her beasts from beside many waters, nor shall the foot of man disturb them anymore, nor shall the hooves of beasts disturb them.
Then I will cause the nations to rest, and their kings I will lead in tranquility, says Hashem Elokim.
When I make the land of Mitzrayim a desolation, and the land is desolated of its fullness when I bring a plague upon all who dwell in it; then they shall know that I am Hashem.

The navi said: A lamentation is this prophecy, and it shall remain a lamentation; the towns of the nations shall wail over it; over Mitzrayim and over all her crowd they shall wail over it, says Hashem Elokim."
And it came to pass in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, prophesy over the crowd of Mitzrayim, and bring her down, her and the towns of the mighty nations; prophesy that they shall be delivered to the lower earth with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction.
Whom do you surpass in strength? Go down, and lie with the wicked!
In the midst of those slain by the sword they shall fall; to the sword she is delivered; they shall destroy her and all her crowd.
The strongest of warriors shall speak to him out of the midst of Sheol along with his supporters: 'The wicked, those slain by the sword, have gone down, they lie still!'
There is Ashur and all her army around their graves, all of them slain, who fell by the sword;

Who were given to burial in the recesses of the pit, the house of destruction; and their army was around their graves, all of them slain, who fell by the sword, who were delivered to ruin because they ruled in the land of Yisrael.

There is Elam and all her crowd around her grave, all of them slain, who fell by the sword, the wicked who went down to the lower earth, who were delivered to ruin because they ruled in the land of Yisrael; and they bore their submissiveness with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction.

In the midst of the slain they appointed a resting place for them with all her crowd, around them are their graves; all of them wicked, slain by the sword, who were delivered to ruin because they ruled in the land of Yisrael; and they bore their submissiveness with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction; in the midst of the slain they were placed.
There are Meshech, Tuval, and all their armies, around them are their graves, all of them wicked, slain by the sword, who were delivered to ruin because they ruled in the land of Yisrael.

And they shall not lie with the warriors who fell of the wicked, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, placing their swords under their heads; and their iniquities were upon their bones, because the terror of the warriors ruled in the land of Yisrael.
And you, in the midst of the wicked, shall be broken, and shall lie with those slain by the sword.

There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in their might were delivered with those slain by the sword; they shall lie with the wicked, and with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction.

There are all the princes of the north, and all the Tzidonians, who went down with the slain, ashamed in their ruin from their might; and the wicked lay with those slain by the sword, and bore their submissiveness with those who descend into the pit, the house of destruction.
Pharaoh shall see them and be comforted over all his crowd—Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, says Hashem Elokim.
For the terror of the warriors was delivered because they ruled in the land; and Pharaoh and all his crowd shall lie in the midst of the wicked with those slain by the sword, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, prophesy to the children of your people, and say to them: If I bring those who kill with the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them and appoint him to be their watchman;
And he sees those who kill with the sword coming upon the land, and blows the shofar and warns the people;
Then whoever hears the sound of the shofar and does not take warning, and those who kill with the sword come and take him away—the guilt of his death shall be upon his own head.
He heard the sound of the shofar and did not take warning; the guilt of his death shall be upon him. But if he had taken warning, he would have saved his life.

But if the watchman sees those who kill with the sword coming, and does not blow the shofar, and the people are not warned, and those who kill with the sword come and take any person from among them—that person is taken away in his sin, but his blood I will require from the watchman's hand.
And you, ben adam, I have appointed you a teacher to the house of Yisrael; therefore you shall receive a word from My word, and warn them against sinning before Me.

When I say to the wicked, 'O wicked man, you shall surely die,' and you do not speak to warn the wicked man from his way—that wicked man shall die in his sin, but his blood I will require from your hand.
Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked man from his way to turn from it, and he does not turn from his way, he shall die in his sin, but you have saved your life.
And you, ben adam, say to the house of Yisrael: Thus you have said, 'Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are rotting away; how then can we live?'

Say to them: As I live, says Hashem Elokim, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from his way and live! Turn back, turn back from your evil ways; for why should you die, O house of Yisrael?

And you, ben adam, say to the children of your people: The righteousness of the righteous shall not save him on the day of his transgression; nor shall the wickedness of the wicked cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness; nor shall the righteous be able to endure through it on the day of his transgression.

When I say to the righteous that he shall surely live, and he relies on his righteousness and commits falsehood—all his righteousness shall not be remembered, and in his falsehood that he committed he shall die.
And when I say to the wicked, 'You shall surely die,' and he turns from his sins, and does what is just and right:
If the wicked restores the pledge, repays what he robbed, walks in the statutes of life so as not to commit falsehood—he shall surely live, he shall not die.
None of his sins that he committed shall be remembered against him; he has done what is just and right, he shall surely live.
Yet the children of your people say, 'The way of Hashem is not fair.' But as for them, their own ways are unfair!
When the righteous turns away from his righteousness and commits falsehood, he shall die in them.
And when the wicked turns away from his wickedness and does what is just and right, through them he shall endure.
Yet you say, 'The way of Hashem is not fair.' I will judge every one of you according to his ways, O house of Yisrael!"
And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month, that an escaped one from Yerushalayim came to me, saying, "The city has been struck down!"

Now the nevuah from before Hashem had been with me in the evening before the escaped one came, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was silent no longer.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, the inhabitants of these ruins upon the land of Yisrael are saying: 'Avraham was but one man in the world, and he inherited the land; but we are many, to us the land is given for an inheritance!'

Therefore say to them: Thus said Hashem Elokim: You eat over the blood of the innocent, and you lift up your eyes to the worship of your idols, and you shed innocent blood—and do you expect to inherit the land?
You rely upon your strength, you commit abominations, and every man defiles his neighbor's wife—and do you expect to inherit the land?

Thus shall you say to them: Thus said Hashem Elokim: As I live, surely those who are in the ruins shall fall by the sword, and him who is upon the open field I will give to the beasts to be consumed, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die by pestilence.
And I will make the land a utter waste and desolation, and the pride of her strength shall cease, and the mountains of Yisrael shall be desolated so that no one passes through.
And they shall know that I am Hashem, when I make the land a utter waste and desolation because of all their abominations which they have committed.

And as for you, ben adam, the children of your people speak about you beside the walls and at the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every man to his brother, saying, 'Come now, and hear what word comes forth from before Hashem!'

And they come to you as student disciples come, and My people sit before you and hear your words, but they will not do them; for with their mouth they show lustful talk, but their heart strays after their ill-gotten monetary gain.
And behold, you are to them like a song of pipes that has a pleasant voice and is played well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not wish to do them.
And when it comes to pass—behold, it is coming!—then they shall know that a navi was among them."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, prophesy concerning the leaders of Yisrael; prophesy, and say to them, to the leaders: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Woe to the leaders of Yisrael who were feeding themselves! Were not the leaders appointed to feed the people?
You eat the good things, and you clothe yourselves with the clean wool, you slaughter the fatlings; but the people you do not feed.

The weak you have not strengthened, and the sick you have not healed, and the broken you have not bound up, and those who wandered you have not brought back, and those who were lost you have not sought; but with force you ruled over them, and with rigor.
And they were scattered for lack of a leader, and they were delivered to be destroyed by all the kingdoms of the nations, and they wandered.
My people strayed upon all the mountains, and upon every high hill; and over all the face of the earth My people were scattered, and there was no one who inquired, and no one who sought them.
Therefore, O leaders, accept the word of Hashem!

As I live, says Hashem Elokim, surely because My people became a prey, and My people were delivered to be destroyed by all the kingdoms of the nations for lack of a leader, and the leaders did not seek My people, but the leaders fed themselves, and My people they did not feed;
Therefore, O wicked leaders, return to the Torah, and I am destined to have mercy upon you; listen to the teaching of the Torah, and accept the word of Hashem!

Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against the leaders, and I will require My people from their hand, and I will cause them to cease from feeding the people, and the leaders shall no longer feed themselves; and I will save My people from their hand, and they shall no longer be delivered into their hand to be destroyed.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am revealed, and I will require My people, and I will inspect them.

As a shepherd inspects his flock on the day he is in the midst of his sheep, and separates them, so will I inspect My people; and I will save them from all the places where they were scattered on the day of cloud and darkness.

And I will bring them out from among the nations, and gather them from the provinces, and bring them to their land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Yisrael, in the riverbeds, and in all the inhabited places of the land.

In good pasture I will feed them, and upon the holy mountain of Yisrael shall be their dwelling; there they shall dwell in a good place, and on good pasture they shall feed upon the mountains of Yisrael.
I will feed My people, and I will cause them to dwell in security, says Hashem Elokim.

That which was lost I will seek, and that which wandered I will bring back, and the broken I will bind up, and the sick I will sustain; but the sinners and the wicked I will destroy, and I will feed My people with judgment.
And as for you, My people, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am judging between man and man, between the sinners and the wicked.
Is it a small thing to you that you feed on the good pasture, and tread down the rest of your pasture with your feet, and drink clear water, and tread down the remainder with your feet?
And My people eat what is left from the trampling of your feet, and drink what is left from the trampling of your feet!
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim to them: Behold, I am revealed, and I will judge between the rich man and the poor man.
Because in wickedness and with force you pushed, and with strength you broke all the weak ones, until you scattered them among the provinces;
Therefore I will save My people, and they shall no longer be delivered as a prey; and I will judge between man and man.
And I will set up over them one leader, and he shall feed them—My servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be a leader for them.
And I, Hashem, will be a God to them, and My servant David a king in their midst; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.
And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and I will cause the wild beasts to cease from the land; and they shall dwell in the wilderness in security, and sleep in the woods.
And I will cause them to dwell all around My Sanctuary, and they shall be blessed; and I will bring down for them the rain in its season, rains of blessing they shall be.

And the tree of the field shall give its fruit, and the earth shall yield its produce, and they shall be upon their land in security; and they shall know that I am Hashem, when I break the yoke of their strength, and save them from the hand of those who serve themselves with them.
And they shall no longer be a prey to the nations, nor shall the kingdoms of the earth destroy them; but they shall dwell in security, and no one shall terrify them.
And I will raise up for them a plant for a lasting name, and they shall no longer be carried away by famine in the land, nor bear the shame of the nations anymore.
And they shall know that I am Hashem their God, My word is their support, and they are My people, the house of Yisrael, says Hashem Elokim.
And you are My people, the people upon whom My name is called, the house of Yisrael are you; I am your God, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning Mount Seir, and prophesy against it.
And say to it: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, Mount Seir, and I will raise the blow of My might against you, and I will make you a utter waste and desolation.
Your cities I will lay in ruins, and you shall become a desolation; and you shall know that I am Hashem.
Because you have had an everlasting enmity, and you delivered the Bnei Yisrael to those who kill with the sword at the time of their ruin, at the time of the final payment for their sins;
Therefore, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, surely I will prepare you for slaughter, and those who kill with the sword shall pursue you; since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed shall pursue you.
And I will make Mount Seir a utter waste and desolation, and I will cut off from it anyone passing through or returning.
And I will fill its mountains with its slain; on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your riverbeds, those slain by the sword shall fall.
I will make you an everlasting desolation, and your cities shall not be inhabited; and you shall know that I am Hashem.
Because you said, 'These two nations and these two provinces are mine, and I will inherit them!'—yet before Hashem the thoughts of the heart are revealed.

Therefore, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, I will act according to your anger and according to your jealousy which you showed out of your hatred for them; and I will make Myself known to do good for them when I take retribution from you.
And you shall know that I, Hashem, have heard all your provocations that you spoke against the mountains of the land of Yisrael, saying, 'They are desolated; they are given to us to be destroyed!'
And you exalted yourselves against Me with the words of your mouth, and multiplied your words against Me; before Me it was heard.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: When all the earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.

As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Yisrael because their land was desolated, so will I do to you; you shall become a desolation, Mount Seir and all Edom, all of it; and they shall know that I am Hashem."
And you, ben adam, prophesy concerning the mountains of Yisrael, and say: O mountains of Yisrael, accept the word of Hashem!
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because the enemy said concerning you, 'Aha! Even the ancient high places have become our possession!'

Therefore prophesy and say: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because they grew haughty and because they thought to desolate and crush you from all around, so that you should become a possession to the remnant of the nations, and you became talk on the lips of talkers and an evil rumor among the people;

Therefore, O mountains of Yisrael, accept the word of Hashem Elokim! Thus said Hashem Elokim to the mountains and to the hills, to the riverbeds and to the valleys, to the desolated ruins and to the forsaken cities, which have become a mockery and a derision to the remnant of the nations all around;

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Surely in the fire of My retribution I have decreed by My word against the remnant of the nations, and against all Edom, who appointed the land of My Shechinah's dwelling to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart and with contempt of soul, to cast it out for a prey!

Therefore, prophesy concerning the land of Yisrael, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the riverbeds and to the valleys: Thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I have decreed by My word in My anger and in My wrath, because you have borne the humiliation of the nations.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: I have raised My hand in an oath by My word: Surely the nations that are around you who plundered you, they themselves shall bear their humiliation!
But as for you, O mountains of Yisrael, your branches shall yield prosperity and your fruit shall be given to My people Yisrael; for the day of My redemption is near to come!
For behold, I am revealed unto you, and I will turn by My word to do good for you, and you shall be tilled and sown.
And I will multiply human life upon you, all the house of Yisrael, all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the ruins shall be built.

And I will multiply upon you man and beast, and they shall multiply and increase; and I will settle you as in your former times, and do good for you even more than at your beginning; and you shall know that I am Hashem.
And I will cause men to walk upon you, My people Yisrael, and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no longer continue to bereave them of children.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because they say to you, 'You are a devourer of men, and a bereaver of your nations you have been';
Therefore, men you shall no longer devour, and your nations you shall no longer bereave, says Hashem Elokim.
Neither will I let you hear any longer the humiliation of the nations, nor shall you bear the reproaches of the peoples anymore, nor cause your nations to be bereaved anymore, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, when the house of Yisrael dwelt upon their land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds; like the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity was their way before Me.
Wherefore I poured out My wrath upon them for the innocent blood that they shed upon the land, and because with the worship of their idols they defiled it.
And I exiled them among the nations, and they were scattered among the provinces; according to their evil ways and according to their corrupt deeds I took retribution from them.

And when they came among the nations where they were exiled, they profaned My holy name, in that it was said of them, 'These are the people of Hashem, and how is it that they have gone out of the land of His Shechinah's dwelling?'
But I had pity for My holy name, which the house of Yisrael had profaned among the nations where they were exiled.
Therefore say to the house of Yisrael, Thus said Hashem Elokim: Not for your sake do I act, O house of Yisrael, but for My holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you were exiled.

And I will sanctify My great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst; and the nations shall know that I am Hashem, says Hashem Elokim, when I am sanctified through you before their eyes.
And I will bring you near from among the nations, and gather you from all the provinces, and bring you into your own land.
And I will forgive your sins as clean water purifies, and as the ashes of the purification heifer; and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you.

A fearful heart will I give you, and a fearful spirit will I put within your inward parts; and I will break the heart of the wicked—which is hard as stone—from your flesh, and I will give you a heart that fears before Me to do My will.
And My Holy Spirit I will put within your inward parts, and I will cause you to walk in My statutes, and My judgments you shall keep and perform.
And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you shall be a people before Me, and I will be a God to you.
And I will save you from all your uncleannesses; and I will bless the grain and multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.
And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, that you may no longer bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
Then shall you remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you shall feel disgust in yourselves, seeing your sins and your abominations.
Not for your sakes do I act, says Hashem Elokim, let it be known to you; be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Yisrael!
Thus said Hashem Elokim: On the day that I cleanse you from all your sins, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins shall be built.
And the land that was desolated shall be tilled, instead of being a desolation in the eyes of all who passed by.
And they shall say, 'This land of Yisrael that was desolated has become like the Garden of Eden; and the ruined, desolated, and destroyed cities are fortified and inhabited!'
Then the nations that remain around you shall know that I, Hashem, have built the destroyed places and planted that which was desolated; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word, and I will fulfill it.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Yet for this will I be inquired of by My word for the house of Yisrael, to do it for them: I will multiply them with men, and make them succeed with cattle.

Like a holy people, like the people who are cleansed and come to Yerushalayim at the time of the Pesach festival, so shall the cities of the land of Yisrael that were ruined be filled with flocks of men, the people of the house of Yisrael; and they shall know that I am Hashem."
